# Swift-visible bridge API (module `markite_macos`, generated by UniFFI 0.29)

Source: `src/lib.rs`, `src/doc.rs`, `src/convert.rs`, `src/errors.rs`. Conversion only; logic and tests of the logic live in `core`.
Tests: `macos/tests/bridge.rs`. Verified against bindings generated on Linux (names below are from the generated Swift).

## Errors
```swift
enum MarkiteError: Swift.Error {
    case NotFound, PermissionDenied, TooLarge          // PascalCase: UniFFI does not lowercase error cases
    case InvalidInput(message: String)                 // invalid/NUL path, finishSave without prepareSave, InvalidData
    case Other(message: String)
}
```
Mapping from `io::ErrorKind`: NotFound, PermissionDenied, FileTooLarge -> TooLarge, InvalidInput/InvalidData -> InvalidInput, rest -> Other.

## Doc (class, thread-safe, `Sendable`)
```swift
Doc()
load(path: String, bytes: Data) throws        // NUL in path -> InvalidInput; drops any pending save plan
text() -> String
setText(text: String) -> Bool                 // true if changed
path() -> String?
isDirty() -> Bool
encodingLabel() -> String
lineEndingLabel() -> String
setConvertEncoding(on: Bool)                  // default on: save converts to UTF-8
setConvertLineEndings(on: Bool)               // default on: save converts to LF
prepareSave() throws -> Data                  // keeps the plan inside Doc
finishSave(path: String) throws               // consumes the plan; InvalidInput if none or NUL in path
externalChange(bytes: Data) -> ExternalChangeKind   // .unchanged / .reloaded / .conflict
wordCount() -> UInt64
charCount() -> UInt64
renderBlocks(theme: String) -> [Block]
```
Save flow: `let d = try doc.prepareSave()`, write `d` to disk, then `try doc.finishSave(path:)`. Edits made in between stay dirty.

## Records and enums
```swift
struct Block { var startLine: UInt32; var endLine: UInt32; var html: String }
struct BlockPosition { var index: UInt32; var fraction: Double }
enum MinimapKind { case blank, heading, code, text, listItem, quote, table }
struct MinimapLine { var indent: UInt16; var len: UInt16; var kind: MinimapKind; var marker: UInt16 }
enum AppearanceKind { case system, light, dark }
enum ExternalChangeKind { case unchanged, reloaded, conflict }
```

## Free functions
```swift
lineToBlock(blocks: [Block], line: Double) -> BlockPosition      // NaN/empty -> (0, 0.0); line past end -> (last, 1.0)
blockToLine(blocks: [Block], index: UInt32, fraction: Double) -> Double   // bad index -> 1.0; fraction NaN->0, clamped 0...1
minimapLines(text: String) -> [MinimapLine]
readLimited(path: String) throws -> Data     // NUL -> InvalidInput; not a regular file -> InvalidInput; >100 MB -> TooLarge
maxFileBytes() -> UInt64
clampWrapColumn(v: Int32) -> Int32           // 60...200
clampPreviewWidth(v: Int32) -> Int32         // 20...100
fontSize(saved: Int32) -> Int32?             // nil if saved <= 0, else clamped 6...40
themeName(family: String, dark: Bool) -> String
appearanceParse(s: String) -> AppearanceKind
appearanceName(kind: AppearanceKind) -> String
themeFamilies() / codeFonts() / sansFonts() / serifFonts() -> [String]
defaultWrapColumn() -> Int32
defaultPreviewWidth() -> Int32
wordCount(text: String) -> UInt64            // placeholder smoke test; remove when the app no longer uses it
```
